solution:
import ast

SRC = 'def run(user_text):\n    return eval(user_text)\n'

def count_eval(source):
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    found = 0
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == 'eval':
            found = found + 1
    return found

found = count_eval(SRC)
print('eval: %d' % found)
